correctness.rationale: Generator images freely parametrize all derivations; the lower-central filtration reduces invertibility to diagonal graded actions. Standard integral Lyndon brackets furnish a nonzero vector for every positive two-generator multidegree, in every characteristic. Consequently the (p,p) weight forces zero at class 2p, whereas irreducible quadratic generator matrices with nonzero trace work below the threshold. The three rational-canonical matrix types give an exhaustive count, including repeated-eigenvalue matrices. Tensor-algebra determinant computations cover every generator matrix over prime fields of orders 2,3,5,7 through the stated classes; extension-field matrix enumeration covers 4 and 9. These experiments check, but do not replace, the general proof.

value.rationale: The result settles a natural all-class invariant for an infinite family of free nilpotent Lie algebras over finite fields: existence precisely below class 2p, a finite-field exact count, and a density plateau across a whole class interval followed by abrupt disappearance. The obstruction comes from a nonzero free-Lie multidegree (p,p), while the positive counts come from irreducible and split rational generator matrices. This supplies structural motivation and a sharp boundary beyond a small finite calculation.
